{{Quote|You knew my mother well – let me remind you when. You met her on Praidaw, came to live with her on Gavens, where she had a house in Torlas – the house in which I was born. You moved with us to Lucazec. And within the year, you left us there.|Akanah Norand Pell, to father|<ref name="SL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
'''Torlas''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CEG" /> [[Gavens]]<ref name="SL" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOCG">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Gavens system/Legends|Gavens system]]</ref> Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Isela Talsava Norand|Isela]] and [[Joreb Goss|Joreb]]<ref name="SL" /> first met on the planet<ref name="CEP">{{CSWECite|III|41|Praidaw}}</ref> [[Praidaw]],<ref name="SL" /> from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOCP">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Praidaw system/Legends|Praidaw system]]</ref> Joreb then came to live with Isela on<ref name="SL" /> the planet<ref name="CEG" /> Gavens, where she had a house in<ref name="SL" /> the city<ref name="CEG" /> Torlas – the house in which their [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|daughter]] was born. Shortly afterward, Joreb moved with his family to the planet [[Lucazec]] and, within the [[Standard year/Legends|year]], abandoned his wife and daughter there.<ref name="SL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torlas was first mentioned<ref name="SL" /> in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|31|Lucasfilm's Latest}}</ref> In [[1998]],<ref name="San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more|date=2020-07-02}}</ref> an entry for Gavens was added to the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that Torlas was a city.<ref name="SWE" />
